saw_lines: Coffee buyers commit to a roaster only after a first bag arrives fresh, then they reorder on a routine without comparing.
So a new buyer who wonders how fresh the beans arrive leaves before reaching your shipping page.
Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 8 ads mention shipping or delivery. Open three new ads with that answer from your shipping policy in the first line.
ads_1: Shipping answered in line one of every new ad, then the Bavarian roasting story
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your two linked channels
